title: Score Interpretation List
description: A collection of score interpretations that imply order via their naming or required proficiencies.

owner.description: The entity that maintains this score interpretation list. Domain name. Ex: 'example.com'

name.description: A namespace to associate the interpretations. Kebab case. Ex: 'my-list-name'

description.description: A brief description of the knowledge domain covered by this interpretation list.

version.description: Version of this list. Semantic versioning format. Ex: '1.0.0'

issued-at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this version was created.

signature.description: ASCII-armored detached OpenPGP (GPG) signature over the protected fields of this interpretation list, used to verify authenticity.

signed-by.description: Email address of the GPG key that produced 'signature'. For convenience only. Verify with signature. Convention: 'proficiency@<owner>'.

score-interpretations.description: Map of score interpretation identifiers to their definitions

dependencies.description: Map of shorthand aliases to external topic list references

^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$.description: HTTP(S) URL to a versioned topic list (YAML/JSON)
